walkthroughs.h2: Why did the Tsarist regime collapse?
walkthroughs.body_html: By 1917 World War I had killed 1.7 million Russian soldiers. Bread shortages, inflation and conscription strained the home front. Nicholas's command at Stavka left government to the Tsarina and the discredited Rasputin (murdered December 1916). Industrial strikes, military mutinies and Duma alienation produced a regime without defenders.

Bread protests on International Women's Day (23 February OS) escalated. By 25 February strikes reached 200,000. On 26-27 February soldiers of the Petrograd garrison mutinied. The Duma formed a Provisional Committee while the Petrograd Soviet convened in the Tauride Palace. Nicholas attempted to return but his train was diverted; he abdicated on 2 March, ending the Romanov dynasty.

The Provisional Government under Prince Lvov pursued constitutional reform but deferred elections to a Constituent Assembly. The Petrograd Soviet's Order Number One on 1 March granted soldiers' committees authority. Crucially, the Provisional Government continued the war. This commitment alienated workers and soldiers and created space for Bolshevik radicalism through 1917.

mcqs.q: What happened in the Russian Revolution of 1917?
options: There were two revolutions: February overthrew the Tsar and installed the Provisional Government; October saw the Bolsheviks seize power from that government.
Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
The April Theses created the Soviet Union.
The Bolsheviks overthrew the Tsar in 1917.

mcqs.q: What did Lenin's April Theses demand in 1917?
options: Lenin's April Theses called for an immediate alliance with the Provisional Government.
The April Theses created the Soviet Union.
Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
No support for the Provisional Government, all power to the Soviets, end the war, redistribute land — slogans summarised as 'Peace, Bread, Land'.

mcqs.q: Why did the Provisional Government fail in 1917?
options: The Provisional Government fell because Lenin was personally more charismatic than Kerensky.
The April Theses created the Soviet Union.
The Provisional Government fell because the Tsar returned and reclaimed his throne.
It continued the unpopular war, did not redistribute land, shared 'dual power' with the Petrograd Soviet, and was discredited by the Kornilov affair before the Bolshevik takeover.
